name: Barentsz in the Arctic
traveler: Willem Barentsz and Jacob van Heemskerck
summary: Seeking a north-east passage to China, a Dutch crew discovers Bear Island and Spitsbergen, then rounds the north of Novaya Zemlya and is frozen in. They are the first Europeans known to winter in the high Arctic, in a house built from driftwood; Barentsz dies on the way back in open boats.

stops.note: A polar bear is killed; the island is named for it.
'Pointed mountains': the first known sighting of Svalbard.
The ship is crushed in the ice; they build a hut of driftwood.
In June they set out in two open boats; Barentsz dies within a week.
Twelve survivors reach a Dutch ship.
